about: The budget month containing a day: it starts on payday (month_starts_on_day) and ends the day before the next one; in shorter months payday moves to the last day. `days` is its length, `daysLeft` counts from `today` to the end, both days included.

cases.name: the calendar month when payday is the 1st
the 1st of January starts a new month
after payday the month runs to the day before the next one
before payday the month started last month
before payday the days left run up to the day before it
payday itself is the first day
a month across the new year
payday on the 31st moves to the end of February
before a moved payday the month is still the previous one
the day before the 31st is the last day of a month that began in February
payday on the 31st across the new year
payday on the 30th in a leap February
